### Fixed
- **vLLM's cache is a subPath of the claim's own — `.vllm-cache` at the claim root, mounted at `/mnt/vllm-cache` on the runtime container with `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT` set in the same rule — and no longer a path under the model's directory** (giantswarm/agent-platform#541). 4.31.0 set `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/mnt/models/.cache/vllm` through `modelServing.policies.env`, and every cold start crash-looped: the storage-initializer's Hugging Face client creates `<model>/.cache/huggingface` as uid 1000, mode 755, during the download, so `.cache` exists before vLLM starts, owned by uid 1000 and not group-writable, and the runtime (another uid, gid 1000 through the claim's `fsGroup`) failed `os.makedirs('/mnt/models/.cache/vllm')` with `PermissionError` — `Engine core initialization failed`; a model whose weights were already cached hit the same directory. The redirect rule now mounts the claim a second time on the runtime container of both pod shapes, at `/mnt/vllm-cache` from the claim-wide subPath `.vllm-cache` (the kubelet creates a missing subPath directory with the claim root's group and mode, `root:1000 2775`, which gid 1000 writes; compiled graphs are keyed by model and configuration inside it, so one directory serves every model), and sets `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/mnt/vllm-cache` on that container in the same patch — the env is never set without the directory behind it, and a pod without the cache keeps vLLM's default cache root. `modelServing.policies.env` is back to `HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET` alone in both charts, and the runtime's `/mnt/models` mount keeps the attributes KServe declares again (the classic predictor's read-only): the runtime writes nothing into the model's directory. `make verify-model-serving-policies` asserts the cache mount and the env together on the runtime container of both shapes and on the storage-initializer neither, the model mount's `readOnly` unchanged, that no mount or env value of the pod names a path under `/mnt/models`, and that a workload pod without a model name gets neither the mount nor the env. An installation on 4.31.0 with a crash-looping model: the next pod after the upgrade starts clean; the `<model>/.cache/huggingface` directory the initializer created stays and is harmless.
